# gsm_project_file_collector_sink (Data Source)

Reads a project file collector sink.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gsm_project_file_collector_sink" "logs" {
  project_id               = "<project_id>"
  file_collector_sink_name = "logs-s3"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_collector_sink_name` (String) Name of the file collector sink
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the file collector sink belongs

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the file collector sink
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `s3` (List of Object) S3 destination of collected files (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `default` (String)
